name: Klaviyo
shortInfo: Klaviyo provides a marketing automation platform, used primarily for email & SMS marketing.
brief: Klaviyo is a unified customer platform that gives your online brand direct ownership of your consumer data and interactions, empowering you to turn transactions with customers into productive long-term relationships at scale.
about: The Klaviyo Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Klaviyo platform in an automated manner.
availableSync:
[Profile](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/klaviyo/syncs/profiles.html)

This sync can be used to upload profiles from your data warehouse to the Klaviyo platform.

[List](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/klaviyo/syncs/lists.html)

This sync can be used to upload lists from your data warehouse to the Klaviyo platform.
